description: One hand on surface. Pull dumbbell to hip with the other. Elbow tight.

name: DB Shoulder Press
description: Press dumbbells overhead from shoulder height, full lockout

name: DB Shrugs
description: Hold dumbbells at sides, shrug shoulders straight up.

name: DB Single Arm Row
description: Brace one hand on your thigh, row dumbbell to hip.

name: DB Skull Crusher
description: On back, arms up. Bend elbows to lower dumbbells beside head. Extend.

name: DB Skull Crusher Burnout
description: Lie on floor, lower DBs to temples, extend to failure.

name: DB Spider Curl
description: Lean forward at 45 degrees, curl one arm at a time hanging straight down.

name: DB Squat to Press
description: Squat with dumbbells at shoulders, stand and press overhead

name: DB Tate Press
description: Lie on floor, elbows flared wide, lower DBs to chest then press up.

name: DB Tricep Extension
description: On back, arms straight up. Lower dumbbells to forehead. Press back up.

name: DB Upright Row
description: Pull dumbbells straight up, elbows flare out to ear height

name: DB Upright Row Burnout
description: Max reps continuous upright rows until failure

name: DB Wrist Curl
description: Forearms on thighs, curl dumbbells with wrists only.

name: Decline Diamond Push-Up
description: Feet up on a surface, hands in diamond shape. Lower chest to floor. Press up.

name: Diamond Push-Up
description: Hands together in a diamond under chest. Elbows tight. Press up.

name: Diamond Push-Up Burnout
description: Hands together in diamond shape, max reps until failure

name: Diamond Push-Ups
description: Hands together forming a diamond shape under your chest. Elbows stay tight to body.

name: Diamond Push-Up to Wide
description: Alternate diamond and wide grip each rep.

name: Dip to Knee Raise
description: Tricep dip on chair, drive one knee up at the top of each rep.

name: Drag Curl
description: Curl dumbbells while dragging them up your body with elbows pulled back.

name: Dumbbell Halo
description: Hold one dumbbell by the ends, slowly circle it around your head.

name: Dumbbell Woodchop
description: Hold one dumbbell, rotate and chop diagonally from shoulder down to opposite hip.

name: Face Pull Burnout
description: Band face pulls, max reps until failure — rear delt burn

name: Flat Bench DB Fly
description: Lie on bench, open arms wide in an arc and bring back together — or do this on the floor

name: Flat Bench DB Press
description: Lie on bench, press dumbbells up from chest.

name: Flat Bench Pullover
description: Lie on bench, hold one dumbbell overhead, arc it back behind head and return — or do on.

name: Flat Bench Tricep Extension
description: On back, arms up. Lower dumbbells to forehead. Extend back up.

name: Forward Press
description: Hold DB at chest, extend arms straight forward and pull back.

name: Hammer Curl
description: Palms face each other, elbows pinned. Curl up, lower slow.

name: Hammer Curl Burnout
description: Alternating hammer curls, neutral grip, no stopping until failure.

name: Hand Release Push-Up
description: Lower all the way to the floor, lift hands briefly, then push back up.

name: Hindu Push-Up
description: From a pike position, swoop chest forward and up in a smooth arc.

name: Incline DB Curl
description: Incline bench, let arms hang back, curl up.

name: Incline DB Fly
description: Upper back on incline, open arms wide and bring together.

name: Incline DB Press
description: Back propped at an incline. Press dumbbells up from chest. Lower slow.

name: Incline DB Row
description: Chest on incline bench, row dumbbell to hip.

name: Incline Push-Ups
description: Hands on a chair or step, body straight, lower chest down.

name: Kneeling Push-Up
description: Knees on floor, hands wide, lower chest to floor — beginner-friendly push-up

name: Kneeling Shoulder Press
description: One knee on floor, press dumbbell overhead.

name: Kneeling Single Arm Row
description: One knee on floor. Row dumbbell to hip with the other arm. Full squeeze.

name: Kneeling Triceps Extension
description: Kneel on floor, hold dumbbell overhead with both hands, lower behind head and press

name: Lateral Raise to Front Raise
description: Raise dumbbells out to the sides, lower, then raise straight in front.

name: Lawnmower Row
description: Wide stance, pull one dumbbell up and back like starting a lawnmower.

name: Lying Tricep Extension
description: Lie on floor, lower DBs to temples with elbows pointing up, extend.

name: Narrow Chest Press in Bridge
description: Hold a glute bridge, press dumbbells with elbows close to body.

name: Neutral Grip Bent-Over Row
description: Hinge forward, row with palms facing each other.

name: Plank Row to Hip
description: In high plank with DB, row all the way to hip — longer range than standard renegade row.

name: Push Press
description: Dip knees slightly and drive dumbbells overhead explosively.

name: Push-Up Burnout
description: Chest to floor, full lockout. Every rep. Go until your arms give out.

name: Push-Up Plank Hold
description: Hold top of push-up position — arms locked, rigid plank — for time.

name: Push-Ups
description: Elbows at 45, chest to floor, full lockout at top. Body straight.

name: Push-Up to Shoulder Tap
description: Do a push-up, tap each shoulder at the top plank position.

name: Push-Up with Leg Lift
description: Do a push-up, at the top lift one leg behind you.

name: Quadruped Row
description: On all fours with knees hovering, row one dumbbell to hip.

name: Renegade Row to Push-Up
description: Row each arm in a plank, then do one push-up.

name: Reverse Grip Curl
description: Curl up with palms facing up, rotate to palms facing down and lower slowly.

name: Row with External Rotation
description: Row DB to hip, then rotate forearm outward at the top.

name: Row with Leg Raise
description: Hinge forward, extend one leg back, row dumbbell with the opposite arm.

name: Scapular Plane Press
description: Press dumbbells up at a 45-degree angle between front raise and side raise.

name: Seated Bicep Curl
description: Floor or chair edge, curl both dumbbells strict with no body swing.

name: Seated Row
description: Seated on floor, feet braced, row DBs to ribcage.

name: Seated Shoulder Press
description: Seated on bench or floor, press DBs overhead.

name: Seesaw Bent-Over Row
description: Alternate arms rowing in a see-saw motion.

name: Seesaw Overhead Press
description: Alternate arms pressing overhead in a see-saw motion.

name: Shoulder Hold
description: Arms out to sides at shoulder height, hold still.

name: Shoulder Press to Lateral Raise
description: Press dumbbells overhead, lower to shoulders, then raise arms out to sides.

name: Single Arm DB Fly
description: Lie on floor, one arm opens wide to floor while other stays stable.

name: Single Arm Overhead Press
description: Press one dumbbell straight overhead, keep core tight.

name: Single Arm Press with Offset Hold
description: Hold one dumbbell at chest. Press the other one up. Switch after your reps.

name: Slow Negative Curl
description: 3 seconds on the way up. 5 seconds on the way down. Control the weight.

name: Slow Negative Curl Burnout
description: 3 seconds up, 5 seconds down. Keep going until failure. No cheating.

name: Spiderman Push-Ups
description: As you lower, bring one knee to the same-side elbow

name: Staggered Press
description: Press one dumbbell up while the other stays at your shoulder. Alternate each rep.

name: Staggered Push-Up
description: One hand forward, one hand back. Do a push-up. Switch hand positions next rep.

name: Step Back Overhead Press
description: Step one foot back as you press a dumbbell overhead.

name: Step Back Single Arm Press
description: Step one leg back as you press one dumbbell.

name: Supinated Bent-Over Row
description: Hinged forward, palms facing up. Pull dumbbells to waist. Squeeze.

name: Supported Single Arm Reverse Fly
description: Hand supported on thigh in a hinge, fly one arm out to side.

name: Svend Press
description: Hold two DBs pressed together at chest, squeeze and press forward keeping constant tension

name: Tall Kneeling Overhead Press
description: Both knees on floor, press dumbbells overhead.

name: Thruster
description: Front squat into overhead press in one fluid motion.

name: Tricep Dip Burnout
description: Hands on chair edge, dip down and up. Max reps until arms give out.

name: Tricep Dips
description: Hands on edge behind you. Lower until elbows hit 90. Press up.

name: Typewriter Push-Up
description: Lower chest, slide side to side at bottom then press up.

name: Waiter Curl
description: Hold one DB horizontally with both hands under the top plate, curl up — peak contraction

name: Waiter Curl Burnout
description: Hold one DB horizontally with both hands under plate, curl to failure.

name: Walkout to Plank
description: Hinge forward, walk hands out to plank. Hold briefly. Walk back, stand.

name: Wide Grip Curl
description: Hands wider than shoulder width on curl.

name: Wide Grip Curl Burnout
description: Hands wider than shoulder width, curl to failure — short head bias.

name: Wide Push-Up
description: Hands wider than shoulders. Lower chest to floor. Press up.

name: Wide Push-Up Burnout
description: Wide grip push-ups, max reps until failure

name: Zottman Curl
description: Curl up with palms facing you. At the top, rotate to palms down. Lower slow.
